svg.title: NOC wall
svg.desc: NOC wall at 3840x2160 in Wall density. A calm, near-monochrome hexbin wall of 18 432 pods across six production clusters, with one glowing failing block (payments pods in prod-eu-west-1) and the external probable origin psp-api. A region by tier segment matrix, three live charts on static X axes, and an incident ticker whose single un-owned SEV2 row pulses at the top of the salience ladder.
